unit_resolution: The 0.3066 in the 7D labels is m/s (displacement / 0.05 s), NOT m/step. 0.0154 m/step x 20 Hz = 0.308 m/s. The earlier flag was a unit mismatch, not a data outlier.
conclusion: No episode exceeds 5 cm/step; frame_index is contiguous (fi_gap=1, fi_nonunit=0). The 845-episode 7D label set is continuous and usable; clipping to +-1 in the label script never binds.
